Round 137 is closed and round 138 is planned. The decision is **CONTINUE**. The advisor was available and I used it before writing and again before finishing.

**Round 137 outcome**
- **Result:** C passed V-0.3d with real browser checks at 1440×900 and 1280×720. There were 0 bugs and no Georgian text left on the round-137 surface.
- **Publication:** the gate published commit `7e6202b` to both remotes, and that commit is the round-138 baseline. The store tree was clean, and I changed nothing in it.
- **Status:** V-0.3d is marked done (მზადაა), so all of V-0.3 is complete.
- **Archive:** the round-137 task is saved as `tasks/round-137.md`, an exact copy. Every planning file I edited was backed up first.

**Round 138: V-0.4a, clip gestures in English**
- **Why it's split:** V-0.4 has about 120 Georgian source lines, too much for one round. I split it by surface into stages a–e, so nothing is dropped:
  - a: clip gestures (this round);
  - b: lanes, plus the workspace track-header selector;
  - c: clip envelope, group header, track meter, Master;
  - d: default track names and the group-name prefix;
  - e: detail panel and the small library/panel helpers.
- **A's work:**
  - All 25 Georgian lines of `ArrangementClip.tsx`: move, trim, fade, cross-track move, Undo labels and titles.
  - Line 1761 of `ArrangementContext.tsx`.
  - The exact English (CL1–CL20) goes into one new `studioClipStrings` object.
  - The "nothing changed" sentence becomes one shared formatter, which the clip-envelope stage must reuse later.
- **Tests:**
  - About 100 test lines in 17 files change to hand-written English. These include the tests that find clips by their `title`; those titles and selectors must change in the same round, or the tests stop finding the elements.
  - A new `clip-strings-ui.test.tsx` covers the three texts that had no UI test.
  - Mutations m53–m60 must each turn the named tests red.
- **C's browser rows:**
  - Moves, trims, cross-track moves and group moves, each with its Undo title.
  - The blocked and no-change cases, the folded-track title and the range badge.
  - A fade check that also measures real audio output on a clip that is audible from its start.
  - The `/studio-lab` and protected-route check, and the network and hydration checks.
- **Also included:** two cheap gate-137 review fixes (the ST33 test title and the doc 113 status).
- **Ableton:** I cited Live 12 manual §6.7–6.9 for the clip-edge, fade-handle and folded-track terms. The Undo label names are our own wording and are marked unconfirmed in Live.

**Backlog changes (v130)**
- One new Low, the half-moved selected-clip line, goes to the deferred polish list (now 189) and will be fixed in V-0.4b.
- One review Low and the reviewer's architecture note are added to the open strings-split checkpoint request for root. That request is still unanswered but does not block anything.
- C's note that an empty-lane click or Esc doesn't clear a two-clip selection is recorded as an unverified signal only. Nothing is scheduled from it.
- `regression-last.json` is unchanged. A regression round is due on or after 2026-10-27, so round 139 planning may have to start with it.

**Why not COMPLETE or BLOCKED:** still open are V-0.4a–e, V-0.5, V-1 to V-3, the approved moves M1/M3/M4, T12-ADVANCED, the 189 deferred Lows, the Tech Lead manual checks, SRW-21 (deferred by the user), PROD-SSR-NUL and PROD-MP3-UNVERIFIED, the regressions, Saba's answers on the ABL-R and DUX-R recommendations, and the phase-2 go-ahead. Nothing external is missing, so it isn't blocked.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop`. Start with `b-round-137.md` and `current-task.md`; the other planning files are listed below.
